charts.title: The design: a direction test on a pair of series where the true direction is known.
charts.takeaway: The estimator saw planted coupling at 97.8 percent of sites and placed its direction at only 0.60 accuracy against the 0.8 required. On real data the reverse rate was 11.9 percent against a 10 percent limit.
charts.n: 135 ring-width sites, median 78 years each; 20 far-site re-pairings; each synthetic arm drawn once per site

steps.label: Tree rings and summer temperature
steps.detail: 135 ring-width chronologies with June to August temperature. Warmth shapes that year's ring. The ring does not shape next summer.

steps.label: Transfer entropy, both directions
steps.detail: Climate to ring is the true direction, ring to climate the false one. Lags 0 to 3 as written, and a variant without lag 0.

steps.label: Controls in the same run
steps.detail: Rings paired with the climate of a far site, both series read backwards in time, uncoupled copies, a shared trend, and a common driver.

steps.label: Planted coupling with a known direction
steps.detail: Synthetic rings built from a scrambled copy of each ring series plus the site's own climate, at the real strength and at a strong one.

steps.label: Rules set in advance
steps.detail: Real data: forward rate above the far-site 95th percentile and reverse rate at most 0.10. Planted strong arm: forward rate above 0.8 and direction accuracy above 0.8.

steps.label: Planted check
steps.detail: Detected at 97.8 percent forward and 91.9 percent reverse. Direction accuracy 0.600.

steps.label: Real data, as written
steps.detail: Forward 15.6 percent beat the far-site bar of 8.2. Reverse 11.9 percent broke the limit.

steps.label: Variant without lag 0
steps.detail: Passed on real data, then detected the strong planted link at 2.2 percent of sites.

charts.title: Share of sites where the estimator detected a link, in each direction, on real data and four controls.
charts.takeaway: On real data it detected climate to ring at 15.6 percent of sites and the false direction, ring to climate, at 11.9 percent, above the 10 percent limit. Read backwards in time the rates were 19.3 and 22.2 percent, and a shared trend alone gave 12.6 and 17.0.
charts.units: detection rate: share of sites, 0 to 1. Transfer entropy scores how much the past of one series improves a forecast of the other. A site counts as detected when its score beats its own surrogates.
charts.n: 135 ring-width sites, median 78 years each; intervals from 57 blocks of sites
charts.baseline: Rings paired with the climate of a site at least 1,000 km away, 20 re-pairings: mean 0.056, 95th percentile 0.082 for climate to ring. The two planted arms are in the next figures.
charts.threshold: Forward rate above the far-site 95th percentile (0.082) and reverse rate at most 0.10. The reverse rule failed at 0.119.
charts.planted: With strong planted coupling the rates were 0.978 forward and 0.919 reverse: the coupling is seen, its direction is not.

charts.title: Direction accuracy: the share of sites where the true direction scored above the false one.
charts.takeaway: With strong planted coupling the true direction won at 0.600 of sites against the 0.8 required, so the false direction ranked at or above it at 40.0 percent. At the real coupling strength that share was 52.6 percent. No reading clears a coin by much.
charts.units: direction accuracy, 0 to 1. A coin scores 0.5.
charts.n: 135 ring-width sites, median 78 years each; one value per arm
charts.no_interval: The result file stores one accuracy per arm and no interval. With 135 sites, one site moves the value by 0.007.
charts.threshold: Direction accuracy above 0.8 in the planted strong arm. It was 0.600 as written and 0.630 for the variant.

charts.title: The variant without lag 0: clean on real data, blind to a planted link.
charts.takeaway: Dropping the same-year term cut the real-data rates to 8.9 percent forward and 3.7 percent reverse, inside the limit. On the strong planted link, which the estimator as written detected at 97.8 percent of sites, the variant detected 2.2 percent.
charts.units: detection rate: share of sites, 0 to 1
charts.baseline: The estimator as written, lags 0 to 3. Far-site 95th percentile for the variant's forward rate: 0.060.
charts.threshold: Planted strong arm: forward rate above 0.8. The variant reached 0.022, so its pass on real data cannot be credited.
